records.text: Jannos Ironwill is a superior macecrafter who sells goods and repairs equipment. His listed services make him a practical stop for weapon work and supplies.
A Witherbark troll encountered in Arathi, this fighter uses Wither Touch against foes in combat.
A Witherbark shadowcaster in Arathi, it summons an imp while out of combat and uses shadow magic against enemies. When badly hurt, it may flee for assistance.
A Witherbark axe thrower found in Arathi, it hurls its weapon at enemies during combat.
A Witherbark witch doctor found in Arathi, it deploys a healing ward during combat to aid its side.
A Witherbark headhunter active in Arathi, it can throw a net at enemies in combat.
A Witherbark shadow hunter can cast Silence in combat.
A Witherbark berserker who unleashes Frenzy during battle.
A Boulderfist ogre from the tribe’s mound northeast of Stromgarde, this fighter meets intruders with blunt threats: “Me smash!” and “I'll crush you!”
A plains creeper is a beast that can use Encasing Webs in battle.
A Boulderfist tribe enforcer, this ogre meets challengers with blunt threats: “Me smash” and “I’ll crush you.” Its combat training includes Demoralizing Shout.
A Giant Plains Creeper is a beast that uses Encasing Webs in battle.
A Boulderfist tribe brute, this ogre uses the same terse “Me smash” threats as its kin. Its Knockdown attack gives it a close-combat role among the tribe’s fighters.
A Boulderfist tribe magus, this ogre shares its kin’s blunt “Me smash” threats, while Frost Armor marks its magical combat role. Drum Fel describes the magi as a challenge in the tribe’s lair.
A Boulderfist tribe mauler, this ogre shares the tribe’s short, aggressive combat threats. Its Fist of Stone attack fits its role among the tribe’s fighters.
A Boulderfist shaman of the Stromgarde ruins’ ogres, known for blunt threats of smashing and crushing attackers. In battle it casts Lightning Bolt.
A Boulderfist lord among the ogres at the Stromgarde ruins, using the same blunt smashing and crushing threats as their shaman. In battle it casts Devotion Aura.
A Drywhisker kobold found around the wetlands. When badly hurt, it flees to seek assistance.
A Drywhisker kobold surveyor found in the wetlands and nearby Arathi Highlands. It casts Frost Armor while out of combat.
A Drywhisker kobold digger found in the wetlands and nearby Arathi Highlands. It uses Defensive Stance while out of combat.
A lone Dark Iron Supplier in the Arathi Highlands who aids injured allies by casting Resupply when their health is low.
A Dark Iron shadowcaster encountered in combat. It casts Shadow Bolt and Immolate, and can flee for help when badly hurt.
A young mesa buzzard, a bird found in the Badlands mesa region. It is a lower-level young form of the mesa buzzard, distinct from the older mesa buzzards.
A mesa buzzard of the Badlands, distinct from the younger and elder forms. In combat it can inflict Fevered Fatigue.
An elder mesa buzzard of the Badlands, distinct from young and ordinary mesa buzzards. In combat it can inflict Fevered Fatigue.
A humanoid identified by the name Dabyrie Militia and found in the Dabyrie area. It is a combatant that uses a combat ability when it gains an enemy's attention.
A humanoid identified as a Dabyrie laborer, found in the Dabyrie area. It can use Pierce Armor.
A Stromgarde Troll Hunter stationed in Arathi Highlands, this humanoid casts Shadow Word: Pain while out of combat. The supplied records show no conversational duties.
A Stromgarde Defender stationed in Arathi Highlands, this humanoid adopts Defensive Stance while out of combat. The supplied records show no conversational duties.
A Stromgarde Vindicator stationed in Arathi Highlands, this humanoid casts Vengeance when a nearby friendly creature is badly wounded.

A Syndicate Highwayman found near Northfold Manor, this humanoid uses Sneak while out of combat. Captain Nials' account describes the Syndicate as one side in Stromgarde's territorial war and asks for help against its forces threatening supply routes.
A Syndicate Pathstalker found near Northfold Manor, this humanoid uses a ranged Shoot attack in combat.
A Syndicate Prowler found in Arathi Highlands, this humanoid uses Sneak while out of combat.

A Syndicate Mercenary found near Northfold Manor, this humanoid flees for assistance when badly wounded. Captain Nials' account describes the Syndicate as one side in Stromgarde's territorial war and asks for help against its forces threatening supply routes.
A Syndicate spellcaster, the Conjuror is recorded summoning a voidwalker while out of combat.
The Syndicate Magus is a spellcaster who applies Frost Armor outside combat.
An elemental called Rumbling Exile, it uses Ground Tremor in combat.
A Daggerspine Raider is a humanoid attacker that uses a net in combat.
A Daggerspine Sorceress is a humanoid spellcaster that uses Lightning Bolt in combat.
Lord Falconcrest is identified as the Syndicate Leader. When greeting someone, he asks whether they bring good news, suggesting he expects an update.
Otto is Lord Falconcrest's bodyguard and speaks to him with confidence, assuring his lord that their plan is progressing and that success is only a matter of time.
Singer is an elite combatant who weakens foes with Demoralizing Shout and can use Dominate Mind in battle.
Kovork is an elite combatant who becomes frenzied as his health drops below half.
Molok the Crusher is an elite combatant who uses a backhand strike in battle.
Zalas Witherbark leads a warband and fights as an elite spellcaster. In battle, he attacks with Chains of Ice, Wither Touch and Shadow Bolt Volley, and can polymorph a hostile target into a sheep.
Nimar the Slayer is a warband leader and elite fighter. He adopts a berserker stance and uses Whirlwind against his opponent.
Prince Galen Trollbane is Thoras Trollbane’s son and personally holds one of the sigils needed to unlock his father’s tomb. He is a well-protected warrior in Stromgarde’s militia-held districts.
Commander Amaren is a battlefield commander who meets combat with Battle Shout.
Geomancer Flintdagger is a named geomancer who takes the field with Fireball and Fire Shield III.

Shakes O'Breen is a Blackwater Raiders captain whose crew is stranded after the naga attack and the wreck of two ships on the reef. He puts his crew's safety ahead of his own, fears the naga will kill him, and relies on his knowledge of the seas to get them home. He works to defend the crew while the salvage effort continues.
Fozruk is a stone watcher and one of the captors holding an unnamed being at the Stones of Binding. He possesses the Rod of Order, which is needed to open the Keystone still restraining the captive.
Lieutenant Valorcall leads the cavalry serving the human prince in Arathi Highlands. He holds one of the Sigils of Arathor, which Zengu seeks to recover.
A Hammerfall peon stationed in the Arathi Highlands, identified by his work role and association with Hammerfall.
A Hammerfall grunt stationed in the Arathi Highlands. In combat, he can become frenzied and use Infected Wound.
A Hammerfall guardian stationed in the Arathi Highlands, identified by his guarding role and association with Hammerfall.
A deckhand associated with the Blackwater crew, found in the Arathi Highlands.

Foggy MacKreel is a watchman who overslept after drinking and now worries that Longbraid will learn he missed his watch. He asks a passerby to deliver moonshine to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore as repayment of his debt, with only 15 minutes left before he is overdue. His remarks suggest he has waited a long time for relief from his post.

Captain Nials commands Stromgarde’s effort from Refuge Pointe after the city’s fall. He speaks of dwindling forces and a weakening hold on Stromgarde, and urges haste against threats to the militia and its supply lines. The badges of fallen defenders matter to him as evidence of their loss; he calls their recovery a duty owed to the dead. He intends to remain in the Highlands until Stromgarde is retaken.

Zengu is a troll at Hammerfall pursuing the recovery of Trol’kalar, the blade of the Trollbane line. He directs the search for the sigils that protect it, pursuing them from Syndicate hands and Stromgarde’s defenders. He regards the recovered sigils as a step toward claiming the sword for his people, and says they will use it to strike against the trolls of Zul’Gurub.

Tor'gan is a shaman in Hammerfall who can reconstruct the Sigil of Thoradin. He investigates demonic traces at Northfold Manor and the Syndicate's apparent link to dark magic. Concerned that Gor'mul never recovered from Doomhammer's death, Tor'gan seeks raptor-sourced objects to make an enchantment that might help Gor'mul rediscover his warrior spirit and find hope in the Horde's shamanistic power.

Quae is an injured scout near Go'Shek Farm who works with Kinelory to watch the farm and track a Forsaken courier suspected of carrying notes to Tarren Mill. She trusts Kinelory's senses in dangerous places. After reviewing the recovered folder, Quae identifies Apothecary Jorell's deadly experiments and wants proof before acting rashly; still recovering from a run-in with orcs, she asks for Kinelory to be protected while the investigation continues.

Kinelory seeks Apothecary Jorell's research at Go'Shek Farm, urging haste because undead may be harming Hillsbrad. Grateful to Phin for giving them friends and family again after the plague, she vows she would destroy the Forsaken if it brought him peace. She trusts Quae's knowledge while acknowledging that Quae is not an expert. Kinelory can use bear form in combat and asks allies to protect her during the search.
Forsaken Couriers carry messages for the Forsaken.
Forsaken Bodyguards protect others in service to the Forsaken.

Apothecary Jorell threatens to find a use for his opponents’ bodies after killing them. He declares that the Forsaken cannot be stopped and invokes the Dark Lady as a source of suffering for his enemies.
Stromgarde Cavalrymen serve as cavalry troops and charge their enemies with Rushing Charge.
Burning Exile is a hostile elemental found in the Arathi Highlands. Its name marks it as one of the elemental Exiles.
Cresting Exile is a hostile elemental found in the Arathi Highlands. It casts Frost Armor and uses Frost Nova in combat.
Thundering Exile is a hostile elemental found in the Arathi Highlands.

Sleeby is a kobold defender devoted to the Great One and the group’s sacred task. He urges his brothers to hold their ground and mocks short visitors; despite that bravado, he may flee for help when badly hurt.
Znort is a kobold defender devoted to the Great One and the group’s sacred task. He warns intruders to leave and fights with a cleave, presenting the task as more important than his own life.

Lolo is a Blackwater Raiders lookout at Faldir’s Cove who greets visitors in the third person. The crew expected a brief stop to gather treasure, but the Maiden’s Folly and Spirit of Silverpine were lost after running aground on a reef temple. Lolo expects the surviving crew to remain longer and points newcomers to Captain O’Breen if they plan to stay.

First Mate Nilzlix is a Blackwater Raiders officer concerned with securing the Maiden’s Folly and Spirit of Silverpine’s charts and logs after both ships sank at the reef. Nilzlix warns that enemy hands could expose the information and bring Fleet Master Seahorn’s punishment, even if the survivors escape.

Professor Phizzlethorpe is a Blackwater Raiders researcher who believes the rune stone in the nearby cave can power goggles for locating the lost elven treasure. He discovered the cave on the crew’s first day and considers it cursed, warning of ambushes as he works. He asks a defender to escort him while he draws energy from the stone; if successful, he reports that the goggles are charged and hands them to Doctor Draxlegauge.

Captain Steelgut is a Blackwater Raiders captain and survivor of the Maiden’s Folly’s sinking. He says the sea flooded the ship suddenly, naga killed the surviving crew, and he went black before ending up saved ashore; O’Breen reached safety. Steelgut mourns his ship and crew and demands the naga responsible be killed, finding some solace in their deaths while insisting nothing can replace his losses. When a would-be helper delays, he answers with a cutting taunt that he might do the work himself.

Drum Fel organizes Hammerfall's defense against the Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres. He recruits soldiers and directs successive attacks, first against the trolls, then the Boulderfist, and finally their leaders in Stromgarde. He is a blunt, battle-hardened commander who values strength and persistence, even praising a recruit's tenacity after failure.

Korin Fel seeks to protect her husband, the Hammerfall commander, from Or'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn, who hates him for defeating him years ago. Korin says her auguries revealed Or'Kalar's trap, but she concealed the ogre's presence because she fears her husband would rush into danger. She accepts that others may judge her silence as weakness or dishonor, and frames it as a form of love and strength.

Or’Kalar is an ogre serving Mug’thol in Stromgarde, driven by an intense hatred of Korin Fel after Korin defeated him years ago. Korin’s wife warns that Or’Kalar has laid a trap for her husband and seeks his death; she asks for help slaying Or’Kalar and bringing his head to Korin.

Doctor Draxlegauge is a Blackwater Raiders scientist who built goggles to help locate the calcified Elven Gems on the seabed. He would rather handle the work from dry land, so he sends others to charge and use the goggles. Once the gems are gathered, he passes them to Captain O'Breen, wary that keeping the treasure could put him and Professor Phizzlethorpe in danger among the pirates.
Deckhand Moishe is a deckhand associated with the Blackwater Raiders.
Prince Nazjak is a rare humanoid who answers aggression with magic and casts spells in battle.
Caretaker Nevlin is a caretaker in the Arathi Highlands.
Caretaker Weston is a caretaker in the Arathi Highlands.
Alaric is known as Caretaker Alaric.

Marez Cowl is a Syndicate warlock operative in Stromgarde, described as skilled and cunning and known for trafficking with demons. She channels shadow magic, interrupts spells, and may flee for assistance when badly wounded.

Zaruk is a Twilight's Hammer contact at Hammerfall who welcomes an ally sent by Myzrael. He says they have much to discuss if they are to bring the Lady back to the surface, and knows how she can be summoned.

At Refuge Pointe, Apprentice Kryten works with Skuerto on Archmage Malin’s research mission. He studies Witherbark materials and can enchant an Azure Agate to activate the Tower of Arathor’s defenses. He relies on field reports to refine his research and is awaiting the return of those gathering reagents and the gem.

Skuerto is a dwarf working with Apprentice Kryten on Archmage Malin’s mission to recover Trelane’s belongings. He tracks the items’ locations, plans each retrieval around the ogres guarding them, and urges care in the tower. Though initially short with visitors, he apologizes and recognizes their work; his attention is divided between the recovery effort and deciding what to do about Stromgarde.

Gor'mul is a captive orc who remembers being bound in a terrible place for years. He witnessed Doomhammer fall to a lance from behind and grieves that he could not die beside his Warchief. Tor'gan's efforts to teach him shamanism meet initial doubt, but a strange power stirs his strength and renews his interest; he says he will listen to Tor'gan for now.
Kor'gresh Coldrage is a hostile combatant who threatens to smash or crush his opponent and boasts that they will die. In battle he can cast Frost Nova.
Deneb Walker is a reagent vendor in the Arathi Highlands. His local role is supplying reagents, alongside the ordinary goods-browsing service.
Vikki Lonsav is a general-goods vendor in the Arathi Highlands. Her local role is selling general goods.
Hammon Karwn is a superior tradesman in the Arathi Highlands. His local role is supplying trade goods.
Drovnar Strongbrew is an alchemy-supplies vendor in the Arathi Highlands. His local role is supplying alchemy goods.

Narj Deepslice is a butcher who offers goods for sale and has a questgiver interaction. His title identifies his trade; the supplied records give no further detail about his stock or quest conversations.
Androd Fadran sells leatherworking supplies. His title identifies the trade his goods serve, while the supplied records provide no details about particular materials or other aspects of his work.

Slagg is a superior butcher who also provides training services. The available options include training, unlearning talents or a pet’s skills, and purchasing dual talent specialization; the records do not identify a particular specialty.
Tunkk sells leatherworking supplies. His title identifies the trade his goods serve, while the supplied records provide no details about particular materials or other aspects of his work.

Graud is a general goods vendor whose services include selling goods and a questgiver interaction. His title gives no narrower specialty, and the supplied records do not detail his stock or quest conversations.
Keena sells trade goods. Her title identifies her broad line of goods, while the supplied records provide no details about particular wares or other aspects of her work.
Cedrik Prose is a gryphon master offering flight service. When attacked, he calls for guards.
Urda is a wind rider master who offers flight service. When attacked, she calls for guards.
A Dark Iron bombardier watches for a delayed explosives shipment expected from the west. His repeated complaints call the missing delivery out as a source of concern; in combat, he uses bombs.

Feeboz is devoted to the Drywhiskers' sacred task of keeping Myzrael imprisoned. He threatens those who would free her, praises vigilance that keeps her buried, and says his own life is secondary to the task. He also professes submission to a superior he calls “great one.”
Fardel Dabyrie is a humanoid found in Arathi Highlands.
Kenata Dabyrie is a humanoid found in Arathi Highlands.

Marcel Dabyrie is a resident of the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi. Genavie Callow names him among the Dabyries whose heads she seeks in her campaign of revenge, after accusing the family of stealing her remaining valuables. That accusation comes from Genavie, so it does not establish Marcel's part in the theft. In combat, he uses Shield Bash and Shield Wall.
Uttnar is a butcher who offers goods for browsing. His butcher's role is the clearest guide to his work.
Jun'ha sells tailoring supplies.

Brumn Winterhoof is an elemental leatherworking trainer. He presents elemental leatherworking as his own craft and teaches a path centered on the elements, requiring proof of affinity through essences of fire, water, earth, and wind. His instruction warns that choosing elemental leatherworking rules out the dragonscale and tribal arts. He also offers training and an option to unlearn the elemental specialization.
Innkeeper Adegwa welcomes visitors with the image of wind crossing the plains. At her inn, travelers can make it their home and browse goods.
Mu'uta is a bowyer who offers goods for browsing.
Tharlidun is a stable master who can help with pet stabling and recovering lost companions.
Refuge Pointe defenders are combatants stationed at the settlement; in combat they can use Shield Bash.
Elder Torntusk's task identifies Hitah'ya the Keeper as the target to kill for the Shackle Key. In combat she uses Shadow Bolt and can cast Renew.

Doctor Gregory Victor is Horde Trauma’s chief physician and head trauma surgeon at Hammerfall. He trains prospective members in triage, teaching that critically injured patients must be treated before the badly injured and those less gravely hurt. His examination sets clear rescue and casualty limits. He welcomes a successful trainee into Horde Trauma and is ready to begin work with them; another physician describes him as a great doctor whose mentorship is highly sought after.

Field Marshal Oslight leads the Alliance presence at Refuge Pointe and speaks for the League of Arathor, which is fighting to reclaim Arathi for Stromgarde and the Alliance. He directs players to seize Arathi Basin’s bases, describing them as vital sources of supplies and a way to challenge the Horde’s dominance. He praises successful fighters, says the League values them as local heroes, and hopes their efforts will help reclaim lost homelands.

Sergeant Maclear handles the League of Arathor’s resource-crate missions in the Arathi Basin conflict. He sends supplies to quartermasters and recommends contributors for commendation; his conditional dialogue urges a hard, fast campaign to reclaim Arathi.

Deathmaster Dwire is a Defiler who directs campaigns against the League of Arathor in Arathi Basin. He urges attacks on Alliance bases and praises cruelty toward their troops; his conditional dialogue warns that even Refuge Pointe could become a threat. He says victories have reached Varimathras and the Dark Lady.

Deathstalker Mortis handles resource-crate deliveries and says he will pass them to the quartermasters, with contributors’ efforts reported to his superiors. His Arathi Basin remarks treat lumber, ore and food as war supplies, and cast denying those resources to the enemy as a way to weaken them.
Targot Jinglepocket is a Smokywood Pastures representative who offers goods and quest services.
Kosco Copperpinch is a Smokywood Pastures representative who offers goods and quest services.

Rutherford Twing serves as a Defilers supply officer, handling care-package work and offering goods. The packages contain rations and bandages for use in Arathi Basin; his instructions tie later ration and bandage purchases to standing with the Defilers. He also charges into attackers and fights with a backhand.

Samuel Hawke is the League of Arathor supply officer. The care packages tied to him contain Arathi Basin-only rations and bandages, with later purchases tied to Friendly and Honored standing. He also offers goods for sale.
A Defiler Elite is an elite combatant associated with the Defilers and uses a cleaving attack in battle.
A League of Arathor Elite is an elite combatant associated with the League and uses a cleaving attack in battle.
Sir Maximus Adams is the Arathi Basin battlemaster. He offers the option to join the battleground.
The Black Bride serves as an Arathi Basin battlemaster. In response to an offer, she thanks the speaker and warns that the Basin's hazards demand experience.
A Syndicate thief in Stromgarde, carrying a Sigil of Strom.

An Alliance flame warden in the Arathi Highlands, this festival keeper speaks for honoring the Alliance’s fires and urges visitors to desecrate Horde flames. The warden’s festival greeting frames the fires as a shared Alliance tradition across lands with Alliance settlements, while the linked Honor the Flame objective concerns the Arathi Highlands flame.

A Horde flame keeper in the Arathi Highlands, this festival attendant speaks for honoring the Horde’s fires and urges visitors to desecrate Alliance flames. The keeper’s festival greeting presents the fires as a Horde tradition across lands with Horde settlements, while the linked Honor the Flame objective concerns the Arathi Highlands flame.
